 Europa League Bayer Leverkusen vs Marseille live online: score, stats, goals & updates | Europa League 2026/27
 Follow all the Europa League action as it happens as Leverkusen host Marseille today, Thursday November 5, at BayArena.
 AS USA Update: Nov 5th, 2026 14:30 EST 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google Bayer Leverkusen have been at their best in the Europa League this season, winning all three of their opening league phase games by a combined score of 8-0. Their Bundesliga form has been considerably less convincing, however. With four wins, three losses and a draw from their first eight games, the German side sit sixth in the standings. USMNT midfielder Malik Tillman is expected to start.
 After a miserable start to the Ligue 1 season, which saw them lose four of their first five games, Marseille have bounced back impressively, winning their last four in a row. Their Europa League campaign has been a very different story, though. They are one of just four teams yet to pick up a point, having lost all three of their opening games . Tim Weah , who was left out of Mauricio Pochettino’s latest USMNT roster , will captain the French side.
